FEAT-4-STORY-63.title: Define Provider Detail Service Contract
FEAT-4-STORY-63.description: Formalize the input/output contract for provider detail lookup including NPI input requirements and structured response fields (demographics, specialties, external links) to ensure consistency across facade and tool layers.

FEAT-4-STORY-64.title: Implement Core NPI Registry Lookup Logic
FEAT-4-STORY-64.description: Build the core service logic to query the CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider data, and normalize key attributes such as name, address, taxonomy, and identifiers.

FEAT-4-STORY-65.title: Expose Provider Detail Lookup via Evaluate Care Facade
FEAT-4-STORY-65.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade to enable tool-based access from the chat agent, including proper request routing and response formatting.

FEAT-4-STORY-66.title: Construct External Reference Links for Provider Details
FEAT-4-STORY-66.description: Generate state medical board links and research site URLs based on provider metadata (state, NPI, name) to support downstream evaluation workflows.

FEAT-4-STORY-67.title: Add Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
FEAT-4-STORY-67.description: Create unit tests for provider_detail_service and integration tests through evaluate_care_facade to validate NPI lookup, parsing, and link generation behaviors.
